# Haiqu

> Haiqu is a quantum computing software company building a full-stack quantum intelligence platform for enterprise, research, and developer teams.

Haiqu helps quantum R&D teams move from application ideas to executable prototypes and run frontier quantum workloads on real quantum hardware. The platform combines agentic R&D workflows, Haiqu SDK optimization, and runtime orchestration to improve quantum application development, circuit performance, and execution cost.

## Docs

- [Backpropagate Observables](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/backpropagate-observables.md): Submit a job to backpropagate observables through the circuit.
- [Build Lr Qaoa Circuit](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/build-lr-qaoa-circuit.md): Build an LR-QAOA circuit for a QUBO problem (synchronous).
- [Cancel Job](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/cancel-job.md): Unified endpoint to cancel different types of the jobs.
- [Compress Circuit With State Compression](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/compress-circuit-with-state-compression.md): Submit state-compression jobs for existing or inline circuits.
- [Compute Analytics](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/compute-analytics.md): Explicitly fire the job to compute analytics on the backend.

- [Create New Experiment](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/create-new-experiment.md): Create an experiment or return the existing experiment with the same name.
- [Data Loading](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/data-loading.md): Data Loading endpoint.
- [Data Loading Estimates](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/data-loading-estimates.md): Data Loading estimates endpoint.
- [Delete Circuit](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/delete-circuit.md): Delete circuit.

- [Get Analytics](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/get-analytics.md): Get circuit analytics.

- [Get Haiqu Algorithm Recipe](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/get-haiqu-algorithm-recipe.md): Return a complete, runnable Python script for one algorithm.

- [Load Classical Data With Data Loading](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/load-classical-data-with-data-loading.md): Submit a classical-to-quantum data-loading job and return polling context.
- [Log Artifact In Experiment](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/log-artifact-in-experiment.md): Log or append an artifact value under an experiment metrics key.
- [Mcp Meta](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/mcp-meta.md): Used by the AI client to understand if process is changed (happens after reload/restart of the server). So the API chat will keep context and reestablish connection.
- [Post Metrics](https://docs.haiqu.ai/api-reference/post-metrics.md): Post user-defined metrics data for the circuit.
